# Squat photo fixtures

The two reference photos come from Free Exercise DB at pinned commit
`f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5`, published under Unlicense:

- `exercises/Barbell_Full_Squat/0.jpg`
- `exercises/Barbell_Full_Squat/1.jpg`

They are used only to test and render the optional photo-reference UI. The app
continues to download its curated photos only when requested by the user.
